da1_strata.definition: syllabus code x parse path (det|gemini) x tariff band (1|2|3+)
da1_strata.reconciles_with_census_leaves_txt: census-leaves.txt prints 'DA1 strata populated: 12' because census_leaves.py counts its own '0/unknown' catch-all as a band. DA1 defines three bands (1/2/3+), so the honest count is 9 populated of 18 defined, with the 2894 unbanded leaves held out below. Not a contradiction, but do not cite the 12.
da1_strata.empty_by_construction: the 9 gemini-path strata; production parse path is det-if-det-succeeded / gemini-if-det-failed, so a det-only corpus cannot populate them at any n

unbanded_leaves.note: marks=0/unknown, fits none of DA1's 1/2/3+ bands; awaiting a human ruling (question 3 on #88). NOT a stratum -- listed outside populated_counts on purpose.

det_failures.consumer: #45 (M2.2 failure-reason census) takes this set as input rather than re-parsing

known_bug_not_fixed_here.detail: _PHYSICS_PROFILE maps 0625 paper 2 to THEORY_CORE, but its cover text reads 'Paper 2 Multiple Choice (Extended)'; paper_type() consults the number map first, so the correct cover-text evidence is never read. All 40 0625 p2 schemes fail; the correctly-mapped p1 parses 40/40.
known_bug_not_fixed_here.effect_if_fixed: moves 40 schemes from the gemini-path set to the det-path set, i.e. it changes a DA1 stratification variable and the preflight denominator

deliberately_not_committed.what: the 250 parsed MarkScheme JSON files (~18MB) and parse.log
deliberately_not_committed.why: they carry CAIE mark-scheme text verbatim; publishing real-paper content is a human decision (MISSION 12.7). Only derived counts and PDF filenames are committed here.
deliberately_not_committed.where_it_was: /tmp/acc57-full/out (not durable -- regenerate with the steps above)
